expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a deletion that removed a member's pantry orders left a gap in
the counts the food bank's grant audits, which is why orders are kept without the member.
expectations.evidence: The message mentions "Deleting orders affects the documented seven-year grant-audit counts" but never raises the earlier incident (the 2024 deletion that left a gap auditors flagged) nor explains that this is why orders are kept without the member.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/accounts.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/accounts.md at step 9; first edit at step 12
